name: Giddalti
title: Levitical musician in the temple
summary: Giddalti was one of the sons of Heman, who was one of the leading singers and musicians in the temple during King David's reign. He was appointed by lot to lead the twenty-second division of temple musicians. His service was part of the organized worship that David prepared for the temple.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as a son of Heman
keyEvents.description: Giddalti is listed as one of the fourteen sons of Heman, the king's seer, who prophesied with harps, lyres, and cymbals in the house of the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Service under his father's leadership
keyEvents.description: Giddalti served together with his brothers under the leadership of his father Heman in the singing service in the house of God, by order of the king.

keyEvents.title: Total number of musicians
keyEvents.description: Giddalti was among the 288 musicians who were trained and skilled in song for the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Lot cast for the twenty-second division
keyEvents.description: The twenty-second lot fell to Giddalti, and he led his division with his sons and brothers, twelve in all.

keyEvents.title: David's organization of temple service
keyEvents.description: Giddalti's appointment was part of David's great organization of the Levites' service in preparation for Solomon's temple.
